row.body: The apartment key is packed with a water bottle and a move-in card; the card says the furnished room is ready, while the test line remains blank.
row.title: Furnished room, pending test

sidecar.gloss: A room is marked ready before its water check is complete.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could hold a room pending any inspection; the card does not identify what was tested.

row.body: the garden hoe and seed sack are packed with treated seed. every kernel has the same cracked green coating.
row.title: field residue on the garden hoe

sidecar.gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
